name: After § 90
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 90a. Calls for the principle of economic, social and regional cohesion to be defined in the MFF for 2028‑2034 as a horizontal principle in the EU’s long-term budget, mandating the assessment of the impact on cohesion between and within Member States for all spending, policies or actions, with the aim of fostering genuine convergence in economic and social progress;
